summary:
A drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians working on an air defence system on Thursday, the first fatal strike in the Gulf state for months. Italy and Kuwait confirmed the deaths and blamed Iran, but Tehran denies any role. In Guinea-Bissau, the military leaders who seized power in a coup a year ago delayed the return to civilian rule until 2028, saying conditions were insufficient to hold presidential elections.

Spain votes on Sunday in an early parliamentary election that may bring a right-wing coalition to power, replacing the Socialist-led minority government of Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. Housing has been the biggest issue of a bitter campaign, and the final debate also covered immigration. An alliance between the conservative People's Party and the far-right VOX could end Sánchez's eight years of Socialist-led rule.

EU leaders failed to reach agreement on the next budget after more than 12 hours of talks in Brussels on Thursday, where they also discussed a new $49 billion loan for Ukraine's economic and military needs next year. They ended the summit early and aim to agree on EU funding in December. The gap between their demands was clear even before they met.

headlines.title: Drone attack in Kuwait kills two Italian technicians
headlines.summary: A drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian technicians working on an air defence system on Thursday, the first fatal strike in the Gulf state for months. Italy and Kuwait confirmed the deaths and blamed Iran, which denies any role.

headlines.title: Guinea-Bissau junta delays return to civilian rule until 2028
headlines.summary: The military leaders who seized power in a coup on November 26, 2025, said conditions were insufficient to hold presidential elections now. The announcement came a year after the coup, when leaders had promised a return to civilian rule within 12 months.

headlines.title: Spain votes Sunday in early parliamentary election
headlines.summary: Spain votes on Sunday in an early election that may bring a right-wing coalition to power in place of Pedro Sánchez's Socialist-led minority government. Housing and immigration dominated the final campaign debate.

headlines.title: EU leaders fail to agree on budget and Ukraine loan
headlines.summary: EU leaders failed to reach consensus after more than 12 hours of talks in Brussels on Thursday over the next year's budget and a new $49 billion loan for Ukraine. They ended the summit early and aim to agree on EU funding in December.

headlines.title: Trump says he urged Putin to pull back military aggression
headlines.summary: Trump said on Thursday he had urged Vladimir Putin to 'pull back all military aggression' against Europe. Zelensky told the BBC that Trump calling Putin 'my friend' was strange and akin to making the same comment about Adolf Hitler.

headlines.title: New Zealand election ends in hung parliament
headlines.summary: In the final count, neither the center-right bloc nor the opposition left bloc secured a majority. Prime Minister Christopher Luxon needs the support of Qiulae Wong's Opportunity Party to form a majority government.

headlines.title: Storm leaves nearly a million without power on Thanksgiving
headlines.summary: A severe storm lashed the US East Coast on Thursday, tearing up trees and power lines and leaving nearly a million people without power. New York City postponed the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade, and hundreds of flights were cancelled.

headlines.title: Hackers breach US Air Force Cloud One computing platform
headlines.summary: Hackers have breached the US Air Force's flagship Cloud One computing platform, people familiar with the matter said. The intrusion was discovered during work to upgrade the system and could put sensitive tactical, personnel and logistics data at risk.
